results.name: actual TS verifier, authority cleanup and all sessions revoked atomically; other owner kept
password required and actual existing Cloud password verifier rejects wrong password
both explicit confirmations are strict and do not create a closure claim
challenge is owner/current-session bound; foreign owner and second session cannot confirm
expired final challenge rolls back complete D1 batch
session/password revocation just before final D1 batch blocks all cleanup
changing same request nonce/session returns conflict
completed replay needs original strong nonce, returns same receipt without re-cleanup or Set-Cookie
two prepared administrators cannot close the last active admin
concurrent same challenge claims commit once and replay original receipt
late owned INSERT/UPDATE and session issuance cannot resurrect closed personal data
old cookie cannot downgrade into visitor writes; static/public read and new login stay reachable
new closed account login cookie insert is denied by DB final guard
authority failure rolls full batch back including closure/nonce/session state
response contains no password/session/nonce/hash and closure never rewrites wallet or source audit
real API.settings require passed then body waited; closure wins and no settings change
real API.admin role require passed then body waited; closure wins and target role unchanged
real API.community body waited after require; closed author cannot publish late
real API.upload arrayBuffer waited after require; closed user cannot upload; temporary R2 object cleaned
guarded prepare.run, DML RETURNING all/first and batch all check final actor atomically
fresh required role is checked at final statement even if account stays active
closure itself works through guarded D1 batch despite deleting its own session; no credential fence remains
existing gateway fact can finish charged settlement after closure; trusted scope cannot write settings/new jobs/body
verified-session internal path can issue after legitimate old-session deletion but cannot write arbitrary settings
closed recipients/teacher cannot receive new friend/message/booking/device facts; retained message remains
actual unified refund kind is refund; internal order gate accepts that existing applied fact independently of pay match
